summary: Iter319 — Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the SB Marketplace / SBDrive VTC admin dashboard. (1) Broken-icons sweep on all 18 admin/billing routes, (2) maps verification on /admin/gods-view & /admin/heat-view, (3) full reports verification on /billing/reports including all 9 charts + ZIP + schedule tab, (4) wallet credit/debit flow on Users, Drivers, and Merchants. ALL TESTS PASSED with 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 broken images, 0 empty/unrendered phosphor icons, and 0 ChunkLoadError occurrences.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: react-hot-toast renders both an aria-live mirror and the visible toast — querySelectorAll('[role=status],[class*=toast]') picks up both, so the captured text appears duplicated ('Solde mis à jour : 5.00 € | Solde mis à jour : 5.00 €'). This is purely a test-artifact, not a UI bug.
Minor (no impact this iteration): /admin/users currently renders 500 'credit-user-<id>' buttons (one per row in the table). If the user list grows large, consider virtualisation to keep DOM cheap.

Observation: the auto-reload chunk-recovery (/app/frontend/src/lib/chunkRecovery.js) was not triggered during this run — no ChunkLoadError appeared on any of the 18 routes, including freshly-loaded ones, confirming the recent phosphor-icons fix is stable.
Observation: /admin/bookings route resolves to a normal admin page (no 404 / no broken state), even though the spec listed it as 'if exists'. Confirmed exists and renders.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 18/18 pages clean, 9/9 reports render, 3/3 wallet flows (Users credit, Users debit, Drivers credit, Merchants credit) successful with 200 responses.

seed_data_creation: Wrote real wallet balances via POST /api/admin/users/{id}/wallet/credit: +5 then -2 on a test user, +3 on driver user_a0f25548a9e7, +4 on merchant user_d926d28c4bd3. Amounts are intentionally small per spec.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — no issues to RCA. The previously-reported phosphor ChunkLoadError has not re-occurred in this iteration; auto-reload recovery handler in /app/frontend/src/lib/chunkRecovery.js was not needed during the entire 18-route sweep.
